source.title: How to install Micropython on an ESP32-C3 Super Mini
source.description: I wanted to make a first video in order to try out using Kdenlive and Uploading on Makertube. Nothing special really, I need to find out how to add some text on the video on post-processing, and remind myself to not move apps on top of overlay text... [ESP32-C3 Product Page](https://www.espressif.com/en/products/socs/esp32-c3) [ESP32-C3 Super Mini - Aliexpress](https://www.aliexpress.com/w/wholesale-esp32%2525252dc3-super-mini.html) [Thonny](https://thonny.org/) After following the instructions for installing Thonny, you have to make sure that your user is added on the dialout system group, otherwise you will get a permission issue. Other than that, things should work as in the video.

editorial.why_selected: Two minutes from unboxing to running code: installing MicroPython on a tiny ESP32-C3 board.
learning_outcomes: How to flash MicroPython onto an ESP32-C3
